newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Big Bad Wolf falls victim to Brazil's gun craze.
newsitem.headline: Big Bad Wolf falls victim to Brazil's gun craze.

text.p: Not even fairy tale characters are safe in gun-crazy Brazil -- just ask the the Big Bad Wolf.

A student playing the part of the canine villain was shot and injured onstage because no one checked the gun used by the hunter who comes to the rescue of Little Red Riding Hood, the Jornal do Brasil newspaper said on Tuesday.
"It's an old gun and gunpowder often builds up. It was just bad luck," the school janitor, who lent his weapon to the student production in Campo Alegre, Alagoas state, said.
Jose Claudevan, who played the wolf, tore off his mask and collapsed in agony after being wounded in the leg during the production last week. He needed five days in a hospital to recover.

In an attempt to tame Brazil's gun culture, the lower house of Congress voted last week in favour of a new law mandating jail sentences for carriers of unlicensed firearms. The bill now has to be approved by the Senate.
